claims.statement: Subscriptions select ongoing activity; notifications are updates from that subscribed activity, not exhaustive repository events or accepted work state.

Selectable subscription scopes include issue/PR/gist conversation, repository activity, Actions CI activity and enabled custom issue/PR/release/security/discussion events; capability availability remains conditional.

Optional automatic watching covers repositories with push access except forks; other accessible repositories can be watched manually. Push authority and watching are not identical authorization or completeness.

General default conversation subscriptions include enabled automatic repository/team watching, assignment, issue/PR creation, comments, manual subscription, individual/team mentions and thread state change. This general list is not a proven exhaustive resubscription transition specification.
Created personal-account-owned repositories are automatically watched by default; this does not establish organization-created repository behavior or desired local policy.
Users choose inbox/mobile/email combinations and personal/thread preferences; subscription review is recommendation, and email headers assist filtering without proving recipient delivery.
Reason labels and review-requested filters explain why updates arrive, not current required review status or acceptance. Apparent misdelivery should be investigated with intended-recipient headers.
Done review uses is:done, consistent with inbox guide; read/unread, Saved and unsubscribe are separate triage states. This concept does not resolve tutorial is:read contradiction by live observation.
Unsubscribe removes inbox item and future updates but qualifying individual/team mentions reactivate notifications. Omitted participation/review triggers are not asserted impossible.
Custom filter examples scope repository mentions; filtered visibility does not provide full subscription or estate coverage, and bulk operations remain separately scoped.

Unsaved notifications are retained three months, Saved indefinitely; unsaving an old saved notification removes inbox visibility within a day. These retention claims do not guarantee immutable conversation evidence.
Community discussion is a feedback route, not an executed support request or authority to transmit private data.
